能不能整个「我是虫族模式」？: "Can you make an 'I am the bugs' mode?"
当天，我就把它做了出来。: So I built it the same day.
现在不用再守家了——你就是虫群本身。: No more defending — you ARE the swarm.
把人类基地的核心拆掉。: tear down the human base core.
对面是六个守军、九座炮塔和建筑、: Against you: 6 defenders, 9 turrets and buildings,
WASD开母虫，J撕咬，K喷酸，: WASD drives the Mother, J bites, K spits acid,
U召战士，I召飞虫，O蜕皮，L冲刺。: U summons warriors, I flyers, O molts, L dashes.
你打出去的每一点伤害都会返给你，: every point of damage you deal comes back,
召唤要它，回血也要它。: summoning and healing both cost it.
站到城门底下磨门，: Stand at the gate and chew it,
狙击塔一炮就是一百六的血。: and the sniper takes 160 HP a shot.
再派小虫子冲门帮你扛火力——: send small bugs to soak the fire —
炮塔永远只打最近的单位。: turrets always hit the nearest unit.
母虫可以死，但最多五次。: The Mother can die, but only 5 times.
每次倒下都会从虫洞满血重来，第五次一到，: Each death respawns her at full HP; on the fifth,
虫群涌入，母虫跟着往院子里冲。: Bugs pour in, the Mother charges after them.
看到这儿要是觉得有意思，顺手点个赞。: If this looks fun, hit like.
我带着母虫直接从门洞往院子里插——堡垒、: I drove the Mother through the hole — bunker,
加农、狙击塔全在两侧，: cannon and sniper on both flanks,
一条命二十秒就见了底。: one life gone in twenty seconds.
这一局的成绩：城门破了，母虫阵亡五次，: Result: gate destroyed, five Mother deaths,
还剩一百一十秒，核心一点血没掉。: 110s left, core untouched at full HP.
说实话，这个模式比我以为的难得多，: Honestly this mode is much harder than I thought —
现在它是真·挑战模式。: it's a real challenge mode now.
有自信拆掉核心的，欢迎来打我的脸。: Think you can crack the core? Prove me wrong.
虫族模式现在就能玩，试玩入口在简介里。: Playable now — link in the description.
